title.zh: 卷七 本紀第七 成祖三
title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七 成祖三 Volume 7 Annals 7: Chengzu 3

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月庚寅，思州苗平。

translations.literal: In year 12, spring, first month, on gengyin, the Si Prefecture Miao were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Yongle, in the first month of spring, on gengyin, the Miao of Si Prefecture were brought to submission.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，發山東、山西、河南及鳳陽、淮安、徐、邳民十五萬，運糧赴宣府。

translations.literal: On xinchou, 150,000 people from Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, and Fengyang, Huai'an, Xu, and Pi were mobilized to transport grain to Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou one hundred fifty thousand laborers from Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, Fengyang, Huai'an, Xuzhou, and Pizhou were levied to haul grain to Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，大閱。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiyou, great review.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiyou, the emperor held a grand military review.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，親征瓦剌，安遠侯柳升領大營，武安侯鄭亨領中軍，寧陽侯陳懋、豐城侯李彬領左、右哨，成山侯王通、都督譚青領左、右掖，都督劉江、硃榮為前鋒。

translations.literal: On gengxu he personally campaigned against the Oirats; Marquis Liu Sheng of Anyuan led the great camp, Marquis Zheng Heng of Wu'an the central army, Marquises Chen Mao of Ningyang and Li Bin of Fengcheng the left and right scouts, Marquis Wang Tong of Chengshan and Commissioner-in-chief Tan Qing the left and right wings, and Commissioners Liu Jiang and Zhu Rong the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he took the field in person against the Oirats; Liu Sheng, Marquis of Anyuan, commanded the main camp, Zheng Heng, Marquis of Wu'an, the center, Chen Mao of Ningyang and Li Bin of Fengcheng the left and right scouts, Wang Tong of Chengshan and Tan Qing the left and right wings, and Liu Jiang and Zhu Rong the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 庚申，振鳳翔、隴州饑，按長吏不言者罪。

translations.literal: On gengshen, relief was extended for famine in Fengxiang and Longzhou; officials who had not reported it were prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen famine relief was sent to Fengxiang and Longzhou, and supervising officials who had concealed the distress were punished.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，張輔俘陳季擴於老撾以獻，交阯平。

translations.literal: Third month, on guiwei, Zhang Fu captured Chen Jikuai in Laos and presented him; Jiaozhi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei, Zhang Fu seized Chen Jikuai in Laos and brought him in captive; Annam was pacified.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，發北京，皇太孫從。

translations.literal: On gengyin he set out from Beijing; the imperial grandson accompanied him.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor departed Beijing, and the heir apparent's son went with him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰朔，次興和，太閱。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, new moon on jiachen, he halted at Xinghe and held a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of jiachen, he encamped at Xinghe and reviewed the host in full.

sentences.zh: 己酉，頒軍中賞罰號令。

translations.literal: On jiyou he promulgated orders of reward and punishment in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he issued the army's regulations for rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，設傳令紀功官。

translations.literal: On gengxu he established officers to transmit orders and record merit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he appointed officials to relay commands and register achievements in the field.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次屯雲谷，孛羅不花等來降。

translations.literal: On dingmao he halted at Tunyungu; Bolbuqa and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he encamped at Tunyungu, and Bolbuqa and his fellows submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，命尚書、光祿卿、給事中為督陣官，察將士用命不用命者。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dingchou, he ordered ministers, the Director of the Imperial Banquets, and supervising secretaries to serve as battle-line inspectors, observing whether officers and soldiers obeyed orders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingchou, ministers, the Director of Imperial Banquets, and supervising secretaries were made battle supervisors to watch whether troops obeyed or disobeyed.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，劉江遇瓦剌兵，戰於康哈裏孩，敗之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiachen, Liu Jiang encountered Oirat troops, fought at Kangharihai, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, Liu Jiang met Oirat forces at Kangharihai and routed them.

sentences.zh: 戊申，次忽蘭忽失溫，馬哈木帥眾來犯，大敗之，追至土剌河，馬哈木宵遁。

translations.literal: On wushen he halted at Hulunbuir; Mahamu led masses to attack and was greatly defeated; pursuit reached the Tula River and Mahamu fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he encamped at Hulunbuir; Mahamu attacked in force and was shattered; the pursuit ran to the Tula River before Mahamu escaped under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，班師，宣捷於阿魯臺。

translations.literal: On gengxu the army withdrew; victory was announced to Arugtai.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the columns turned homeward and the triumph was proclaimed to Arugtai.

sentences.zh: 戊午，次三峰山，阿魯臺遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On wuwu he halted at Sanfeng Mountain; Arugtai sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he encamped at Sanfeng Mountain, and Arugtai dispatched envoys to pay homage.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以敗瓦剌詔天下。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict announced the defeat of the Oirats throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an imperial proclamation spread word of the victory over the Oirats to the empire.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊子，次紅橋。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuzi, he halted at Hong Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuzi, he encamped at Hong Bridge.

sentences.zh: 詔六師入關有踐田禾取民畜產者，以軍法論。

translations.literal: An edict: if any of the six armies entering the passes trampled standing grain or seized the people's livestock and goods, they would be judged by military law.
translations.idiomatic: He decreed that soldiers of the six armies passing the frontier who trampled crops or took private livestock would answer under martial law.

sentences.zh: 己亥，次沙河，皇太子遣使來迎。

translations.literal: On jihai he halted at Shahe; the crown prince sent envoys to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he encamped at Shahe while the crown prince sent envoys to meet him.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑朔，至北京，禦奉天殿受朝賀。

translations.literal: Eighth month, new moon on xinchou, he arrived at Beijing, held court at Fengtian Hall, and received congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new moon of xinchou, he reached Beijing, took the throne at Fengtian Hall, and received the court's homage.

sentences.zh: 丙午，蠲北京州縣租二年。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Beijing prefectures and counties were exempted from rent for two years.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu land tax in Beijing's prefectures and counties was remitted for two years.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賞從征將士。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the officers and soldiers who had followed the campaign were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the emperor rewarded the troops who had marched on the expedition.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，郭亮、徐亨備開平。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guiwei, Guo Liang and Xu Heng made ready at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guiwei, Guo Liang and Xu Heng were posted to guard Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，靖州苗平。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Jingzhou Miao were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Miao of Jingzhou were brought to submission.

sentences.zh: 甲午，費瓛鎮甘肅，劉江鎮遼東。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Fei Ying garrisoned Gansu and Liu Jiang garrisoned Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Fei Ying was stationed in Gansu and Liu Jiang in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲辰，以太子遣使迎駕緩，徵侍讀黃淮，侍講楊士奇，正字金問及洗馬楊溥、芮善下獄，未幾釋士奇復職。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiachen, because the crown prince's envoys had been slow to welcome the imperial progress, Reader-in-waiting Huang Huai, Lecturer Yang Shiqi, Corrector Jin Wen, and Junior Tutors Yang Pu and Rui Shan were imprisoned; before long Shiqi was released and restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiachen, because the crown prince's welcome had been dilatory, Huang Huai, Yang Shiqi, Jin Wen, Yang Pu, and Rui Shan were cast into prison; Shiqi was soon freed and returned to his post.

sentences.zh: 甲子，召吳高還。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wu Gao was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wu Gao was summoned back to court.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，都督硃榮鎮大同。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Commissioner-in-chief Zhu Rong garrisoned Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Zhu Rong was posted to garrison Datong.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲辰，錄因。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, on jiachen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiachen, the emperor reviewed criminal cases.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，廢晉王濟熺為庶人。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Prince Jin Ji Xi was deposed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Prince Jin, Ji Xi, was reduced to commoner rank.

sentences.zh: 庚申，蠲蘇、松、杭、嘉、湖水災田租四十七萬九千余石。

translations.literal: On gengshen, 479,000-odd shi of rent on flood-stricken fields in Suzhou, Songjiang, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen more than four hundred seventy-nine thousand piculs of grain rent were forgiven on fields flooded in Suzhou, Songjiang, Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and the lake districts.

sentences.zh: 是年，泥八剌國沙的新葛來朝，封為王。

translations.literal: That year Shakti Simha of the Dipamkara country came to court and was enfeoffed as king.
translations.idiomatic: In that year Shakti Simha of Nepal came to court and was invested as king.

sentences.zh: 彭亨、烏斯茂入貢。

translations.literal: Pahang and Wusimao entered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came with tribute from Pahang and Wusimao.

sentences.zh: 真臘進金縷衣。

translations.literal: Cambodia presented gold-threaded robes.
translations.idiomatic: Cambodia sent robes woven with gold thread.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山王貢馬。

translations.literal: The king of Zhongshan in Ryukyu presented horses.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Zhongshan in the Ryukyus presented horses.

sentences.zh: 榜葛剌貢麒麟。

translations.literal: Bengal presented a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Bengal sent a qilin as tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月丙午，塞居庸以北隘口。

translations.literal: Year 13, spring, first month, on bingwu, passes north of Juyong were blocked.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Yongle, in the first month of spring, on bingwu, the mountain passes north of Juyong were sealed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，馬哈木謝罪請朝貢，許之。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Mahamu apologized and asked to come to court with tribute; this was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Mahamu begged pardon and sought leave to present tribute at court, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，北京午門災。

translations.literal: On renzi, Beijing's Meridian Gate burned.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi fire destroyed the Meridian Gate at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊午，敕內外諸司蠲諸宿逋，將士軍官犯罪者悉宥之。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict ordered all offices within and without to remit old arrears, and all crimes by soldiers and officers were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu an edict forgave accumulated tax arrears throughout the bureaucracy and granted amnesty to soldiers and officers guilty of offenses.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，遣指揮劉斌、給事中張磐等十二人巡視山西、山東、大同、陜西、甘肅、遼東軍操練、屯政，核實以聞。

translations.literal: Second month, on guiyou, Commanders Liu Bin and Supervising Secretary Zhang Pan and eleven others were sent to inspect military drill and garrison farming in Shanxi, Shandong, Datong, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Liaodong and report truthfully.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guiyou, Liu Bin, Zhang Pan, and ten others were dispatched to tour Shanxi, Shandong, Datong, Shaanxi, Gansu, and Liaodong, verifying troop training and garrison agriculture.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命行在禮部會試天下貢士。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the traveling Ministry of Rites held the metropolitan examination for tribute scholars from the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the traveling secretariat of Rites examined tribute students from throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 癸未，張輔等師還。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Zhang Fu and the other armies returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Zhang Fu's army came back to court.

sentences.zh: 戊子，論平交阯功，賞賚有差。

translations.literal: On wuzi, merits in pacifying Jiaozhi were discussed; rewards and gifts were graded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi rewards for the pacification of Annam were apportioned according to merit.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，策士於北京，賜陳循等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, on jihai, scholars were examined at Beijing; Chen Xun and others were granted jinshi, Presented Scholar, and Regular Graduate ranks in grades.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jihai, the palace examination was held at Beijing; Chen Xun and the new jinshi were graduated as Presented Scholars and Regular Graduates in their several ranks.

sentences.zh: 丙午，廣西蠻叛，指揮同知葛森討平之。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Guangxi tribes rebelled; Commandant Ge Sen suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Guangxi tribes rose; Commandant Ge Sen crushed the revolt and restored order.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊辰，張輔鎮交阯。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuchen, Zhang Fu garrisoned Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuchen, Zhang Fu was posted to garrison Annam.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on dingyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of dingyou, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，鑿清江浦，通北京漕運。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Qingjiang Canal was cut through to open the Beijing grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Qingjiangpu channel was opened to carry tribute grain to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 六月，振北京、河南、山東水災。

translations.literal: Sixth month, flood disasters in Beijing, Henan, and Shandong were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month relief was extended to flood victims in Beijing, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸卯，鄭和還。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on maoyin, Zheng He returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on maoyin, Zheng He came back from the sea.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，四川戎縣山都掌蠻平。

translations.literal: On bis, the Shanduzhang Miao of Rong County in Sichuan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On bis the Shanduzhang tribes of Rong County in Sichuan were subdued.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，振山東、河南、北京順天州縣饑。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen, famine in Shandong, Henan, and Shuntian prefectures of Beijing was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengchen, famine relief was sent to Shandong, Henan, and the Shuntian districts around Beijing.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，北京地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renxu, Beijing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, an earthquake struck Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on jiashen, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, the emperor hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，法司奏侵冒官糧者，帝怒，命戮之。

translations.literal: On renchen, the judicial offices memorialized those who had embezzled official grain; the emperor was angry and ordered them executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the judiciary reported officials who had stolen state grain; enraged, the emperor commanded their execution.

sentences.zh: 及覆奏，帝曰：「朕過矣，仍論如律，自今死罪者皆五覆奏，著為令。

translations.literal: When the review was submitted again, the emperor said: "I was at fault; still judge according to law. From now on all death sentences shall receive fivefold memorial review; let this be established as regulation."
translations.idiomatic: On reconsideration the emperor said, "I was wrong—sentence them as the code provides. Hereafter every capital case must pass five reviews before execution," and he made the rule permanent.

sentences.zh: 」十二月，蠲順天、蘇州、鳳陽、浙江、湖廣、河南、山東州縣水旱田租。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, rent on flood- and drought-stricken fields in Shuntian, Suzhou, Fengyang, Zhejiang, Huguang, Henan, and Shandong prefectures and counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month land tax was forgiven on fields stricken by flood or drought in Shuntian, Suzhou, Fengyang, Zhejiang, Huguang, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球山南、山北，爪哇西王，占城，古裏，柯枝，南渤利，甘巴裏，滿剌加，忽魯謨斯，哈密，哈烈，撒馬兒罕，火州，土魯番，蘇門答剌，俺都淮，失剌思入貢。

translations.literal: That year the southern and northern kings of Ryukyu, the western king of Java, Champa, Calicut, Cochin, South Pacifier, Gambali, Malacca, Hormuz, Hami, Herat, Samarkand, Huozhou, Turfan, Samudera, Andkhui, and Shiraz entered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year tribute came from Ryukyu's southern and northern courts, Java's western king, Champa, Calicut, Cochin, South Pacifier, Gambali, Malacca, Hormuz, Hami, Herat, Samarkand, Huozhou, Turfan, Samudera, Andkhui, and Shiraz.

sentences.zh: 麻林及諸番進麒麟、天馬、神鹿。

translations.literal: Malin and various foreign lands presented qilin, heavenly horses, and divine deer.
translations.idiomatic: Malindi and other overseas realms sent qilin, heavenly horses, and spirit deer.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者再。

translations.literal: Zhongshan in Ryukyu entered tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongshan in the Ryukyus presented tribute on two occasions.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月己酉，北京、河南、山東饑，免永樂十二年逋租，發粟一百三十七萬石有奇振之。

translations.literal: Year 14, spring, first month, on jiyou, Beijing, Henan, and Shandong suffered famine; arrears of rent from Yongle year 12 were remitted and more than 1,370,000 shi of grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Yongle, in the first month of spring, on jiyou, famine gripped Beijing, Henan, and Shandong; delinquent rents from the twelfth year of Yongle were canceled and more than one million three hundred seventy thousand piculs of grain were distributed in relief.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，都督金玉討山西廣靈山寇，平之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Commissioner-in-chief Jin Yu attacked bandits on Guangling Mountain in Shanxi and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Jin Yu led troops against brigands on Guangling Mountain in Shanxi and subdued them.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，都督梁福鎮胡廣、貴州。

translations.literal: Third month, on guisi, Commissioner-in-chief Liang Fu garrisoned Huguang and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, Liang Fu was posted to garrison Huguang and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，阿魯臺敗瓦剌，來獻捷。

translations.literal: On renyin, Arugtai defeated the Oirats and came to present a victory report.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Arugtai routed the Oirats and sent envoys bearing news of the triumph.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，禮部尚書呂震請封禪。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renshen, Minister of Rites Lü Zhen requested feng and shan sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen, Lü Zhen, Minister of Rites, memorialized for the feng and shan rites on Mount Tai.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「今天下雖無事，四方多水旱疾疫，安敢自謂太平。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though the realm is now without warfare, the four quarters suffer much flood, drought, and pestilence—how dare I call it great peace?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied, "Even if arms are still, flood, drought, and plague afflict the provinces—I dare not proclaim an age of peace."

sentences.zh: 且《六經》無封禪之文，事不師古，甚無謂也。

translations.literal: "Moreover the Six Classics contain no text on feng and shan; affairs that do not take antiquity as teacher are utterly meaningless."
translations.idiomatic: "Besides, the Six Classics know nothing of feng and shan; to break with precedent for empty ceremony would be folly."

sentences.zh: 」不聽。

translations.literal: He did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: The request was refused.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，胡廣為文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: On yihai, Hu Guang became Grand Academician of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Hu Guang was appointed Grand Academician of the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，都督同知蔡福等備倭山東。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on dingmao, Vice Commissioner-in-chief Cai Fu and others made ready against Japanese pirates in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao, Cai Fu and fellow officers were stationed to guard Shandong against wokou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，遣使捕北京、河南、山東州縣蝗。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingyou, envoys were sent to capture locusts in Beijing, Henan, and Shandong prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, envoys were dispatched to hunt locusts through the prefectures and counties of Beijing, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，河決開封。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Yellow River broke through at Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，錦衣衛指揮使紀綱有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: On bis, Commander Ji Gang of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, guilty of crime, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bis Ji Gang, commander of the Embroidered-Uniform Guard, was put to death for his offenses.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉旦，壽星見，禮臣請上表賀，不許。

translations.literal: Eighth month, at dawn on guiyou, the longevity star appeared; ritual officials requested a congratulatory memorial; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, at dawn on guiyou, a longevity star was seen; the Ministry of Rites asked to memorialize felicitations, but the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，作北京西宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the western palace at Beijing was built.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai work began on Beijing's western palace.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on maoyin, the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on maoyin, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，發北京。

translations.literal: On wushen, he set out from Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the emperor departed Beijing.

sentences.zh: 冬下月丁丑，次鳳陽，祀皇陵。

translations.literal: Winter, lower month, on dingchou, he halted at Fengyang and sacrificed at the imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the lower month of winter, on dingchou, he encamped at Fengyang and offered sacrifice at the imperial mausolea.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至自北京，謁孝陵。

translations.literal: On guiwei, having returned from Beijing, he paid homage at the Xiaoling tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, back from Beijing, he performed rites at the tomb of the founding emperor.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，詔文武群臣集議營建北京。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin, an edict ordered civil and military officials to assemble and deliberate on building Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin, civil and military ministers were summoned to conference on constructing Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，召張輔還。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Zhang Fu was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhang Fu was recalled to court.

sentences.zh: 戊申，漢王高煦有罪，削二護衛。

translations.literal: On wushen, Prince of Han Zhu Gaoxu, guilty of crime, had two guards stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhu Gaoxu, Prince of Han, was punished by the removal of two guard units.

sentences.zh: 徙山東、山西、湖廣流民於保安州，賜復三年。

translations.literal: Wandering people of Shandong, Shanxi, and Huguang were moved to Bao'an Prefecture and given three years' tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Displaced subjects from Shandong, Shanxi, and Huguang were resettled in Bao'an Prefecture and granted three years without corvée or tax.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，鄭和復使西洋。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingmao, Zheng He again sailed to the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, Zheng He put to sea again on a voyage to the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、古裏、爪哇、滿剌加、蘇門答剌、南巫裏、浡泥、彭亨、錫蘭山、溜山、南渤利、阿丹、麻林、忽魯謨斯、柯枝入貢。

translations.literal: That year Champa, Calicut, Java, Malacca, Samudera, South Lamuri, Brunei, Pahang, Ceylon, Malindi, South Pacifier, Aden, Malin, Hormuz, and Cochin entered tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year tribute arrived from Champa, Calicut, Java, Malacca, Samudera, South Lamuri, Brunei, Pahang, Ceylon, Malindi, South Pacifier, Aden, Malin, Hormuz, and Cochin.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者再。

translations.literal: Zhongshan in Ryukyu entered tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongshan in the Ryukyus sent tribute on two occasions.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year 15, spring, first month, on dingyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Yongle, in the first month of spring, on dingyou, the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 壬子，平江伯陳瑄督漕，運木赴北京。

translations.literal: On renzi, Grand Mentor Chen Xuan supervised the grain transport and shipped timber to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Chen Xuan, Earl of Pingjiang, took charge of the Grand Canal and sent timber north to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，谷王橞有罪，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: Second month, on guihai, Prince of Gu Zhu Gaochou, guilty of crime, was deposed to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guihai, Zhu Gaochou, Prince of Gu, was stripped of rank and reduced to a commoner.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，豐城侯李彬鎮交阯。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Marquis Li Bin of Fengcheng garrisoned Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Bin, Marquis of Fengcheng, was posted to garrison Annam.

sentences.zh: 壬申，泰寧侯陳珪董建北京，柳升、王通副之。

translations.literal: On renshen, Marquis Chen Gui of Taining directed construction at Beijing; Liu Sheng and Wang Tong assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Chen Gui, Marquis of Taining, was put in charge of building Beijing, with Liu Sheng and Wang Tong as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，交阯始貢士至京師。

translations.literal: Third month, on dinghai, Jiaozhi for the first time sent examination graduates to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dinghai, Annam for the first time sent examination graduates to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙申，雜犯死罪以下囚，輸作北京贖罪。

translations.literal: On bingshen, prisoners guilty of miscellaneous offenses up to death were allowed to redeem punishment by labor at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen convicts below the death penalty for mixed offenses were permitted to work off their sentences on projects at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，漢王高煦有罪，徙封樂安州。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Prince of Han Gaoxu, guilty of crime, was moved to a fief at Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Prince Han, Zhu Gaoxu, was demoted and transferred to a fief at Le'an.

sentences.zh: 壬子，北巡，發京師，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On renzi, on a northern tour he set out from the capital; the crown prince supervised the state.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he began a northern progress, leaving the capital while the crown prince governed as regent.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，次邾城。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jisi, he halted at Zhucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jisi, he encamped at Zhucheng.

sentences.zh: 申禁軍士毋踐民田稼，有傷者除今年租。

translations.literal: He strictly forbade soldiers to trample the people's standing grain; where damage occurred, that year's rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade troops to tread on standing crops, and wherever fields were harmed the year's land tax was canceled.

sentences.zh: 或先被水旱逋租，亦除之。

translations.literal: Where rent was already in arrears from prior flood or drought, that too was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Back rent owed from earlier flood or drought was forgiven as well.

sentences.zh: 癸未，西宮成。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Western Palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the Western Palace at Beijing was finished.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，至北京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingxu, he arrived at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, the court reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，李彬討交阯賊黎核，斬之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Li Bin campaigned against the Jiaozhi rebel Li He and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Li Bin marched against the Jiaozhi bandit Li He and executed him.

sentences.zh: 己亥，中官張謙使西洋還。

translations.literal: On jihai, the eunuch Zhang Qian returned from his mission to the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the eunuch Zhang Qian came back from the voyage to the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 敗倭寇於金鄉衛。

translations.literal: Japanese pirates were defeated at Jinxiang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Wokou were routed at Jinxiang Guard.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲午，甌寧人進金丹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiawu, a man of Ouning presented a golden elixir.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiawu, a man from Ouning offered an alchemical golden pill.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「此妖人也。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This man is a sorcerer.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is a charlatan.

sentences.zh: 令自餌之，毀其方舊。

translations.literal: Order him to take it himself, and destroy his old recipes."
translations.idiomatic: Make him swallow his own drug, and burn every formula he keeps."

sentences.zh: 」九月丁卯，曲阜孔了廟成，帝親制文勒石。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingmao, the Confucius temple at Qufu was completed; the Emperor personally composed an inscription and had it carved on stone.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingmao, the Confucius temple at Qufu was completed, and the Emperor wrote the commemorative text himself and ordered it cut into stone.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，李彬敗交阯賊楊進江，斬之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Li Bin defeated the Jiaozhi rebel Yang Jinjiang and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Li Bin crushed the Jiaozhi rebel Yang Jinjiang and put him to death.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，禮部尚書趙羽兵部尚書，巡視塞北屯戍軍民利弊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Minister of Rites Zhao Hu was made Minister of War and sent to inspect the gains and losses of garrison troops and civilians on the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiyou, Zhao Hu was moved from the Ministry of Rites to the Ministry of War and dispatched to review the welfare of frontier garrisons and their settled populations.

sentences.zh: 是年，西洋蘇祿東西峒王來朝。

translations.literal: That year, the eastern and western kings of the Sulu Islands in the Western Ocean came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In that year the eastern and western kings of Sulu in the Western Ocean presented themselves at court.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山、別失八里、琉球山南、真臘、氵孛泥、占城、暹羅、哈烈，撒馬兒人貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu's central king, Beshbalik, Ryukyu's southern king, Zhenla, Brunei, Champa, Siam, Herat, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from the central king of Ryukyu, Beshbalik, the southern king of Ryukyu, Zhenla, Brunei, Champa, Siam, Herat, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月甲寅，交阯黎利反，都督硃廣擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the sixteenth year, first month, on jiayin, the Jiaozhi rebel Li Li rose; Regional Commander Zhu Guang defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, first month of spring, on jiayin, Li Li of Jiaozhi rebelled, and Regional Commander Zhu Guang beat him back.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，倭陷松門衛，按察司僉事石魯坐誅。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Japanese took Songmen Guard; Surveillance Vice Commissioner Shi Lu was executed for his post.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Japanese seized Songmen Guard, and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Shi Lu was put to death for dereliction.

sentences.zh: 興安伯徐亨、都督夏貴備開平。

translations.literal: Xing'an Earl Xu Heng and Regional Commander Xia Gui prepared defenses at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: Earl Xu Heng of Xing'an and Regional Commander Xia Gui took up defense at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，交阯四忙縣賊殺知縣歐陽智以叛，李彬遣將擊走之。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinchou, rebels in Simang County, Jiaozhi, killed Magistrate Ouyang Zhi and rose; Li Bin sent generals who drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, bandits in Simang County, Jiaozhi, slew Magistrate Ouyang Zhi and rebelled; Li Bin sent officers who scattered them.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，賜李騏等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiayin, Li Qi and other metropolitan graduates were granted jinshi with ranks of Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiayin, Li Qi and the new jinshi were graduated into the Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate ranks as their marks allowed.

sentences.zh: 都督僉事劉鑒備邊大同。

translations.literal: Regional Commander Liu Jian prepared the border at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Regional Commander Liu Jian garrisoned the Datong frontier.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚戌，重修《太祖實錄》成。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on gengxu, the revised Veritable Records of the Founding Emperor were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on gengxu, the revised Veritable Records of Taizu were finished.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，胡廣卒。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Hu Guang died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Hu Guang died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，敕責陜西諸司：「比聞所屬歲屢不登，致民流莩，有司坐視不恤，又不以聞，其咎安在。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, an edict rebuked the Shaanxi offices: "We have lately heard that in your jurisdictions harvests have repeatedly failed, causing the people to wander in destitution; the officials sit by without relief and do not report it—where does the blame lie?
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, an edict upbraided the Shaanxi authorities: "We hear that your districts have suffered repeated crop failure, so that people roam starving, while officials look on without succor and never inform the throne—whose fault is this?

sentences.zh: 其速發倉儲振之。

translations.literal: Quickly open the granaries and relieve them."
translations.idiomatic: Open the granaries at once and give relief."

sentences.zh: 」贊善梁潛、司諫周冕以輔導皇太子有闕，皆下獄死。

translations.literal: Tutor Liang Qian and Remonstrance Officer Zhou Mian were found wanting in instructing the Crown Prince; both were imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: The tutors Liang Qian and Remonstrance Officer Zhou Mian were judged to have failed the Crown Prince in instruction; both were thrown into prison and died there.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月戊子，諭法司：「朕屢敕中外官潔己愛民，而不肖官吏恣肆自若，百姓苦之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on wuzi, the legal offices were instructed: "We have repeatedly charged officials within and without to keep themselves clean and love the people, yet unworthy officers remain wanton as before and the common people suffer.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on wuzi, the judiciary was told: "We have again and again ordered every officer to live cleanly and cherish the people, yet the worthless still swagger as they please while the folk endure misery.

sentences.zh: 夫良農必去稂莠者，為害苗也。

translations.literal: A good farmer must remove darnel, for it harms the grain.
translations.idiomatic: A careful farmer uproots the tares that choke the crop.

sentences.zh: 繼今，犯贓必論如法。

translations.literal: Henceforth, those who take bribes shall be punished according to law."
translations.idiomatic: From this time forward, anyone guilty of graft shall be dealt with by the full penalty of the code."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，成山侯王通馳傳振陜西饑。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Chengshan Earl Wang Tong rode post-haste to relieve famine in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Earl Wang Tong of Chengshan rushed by relay to bring famine relief to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、占城、爪哇、蘇門答剌、泥八剌、滿剌加、南渤利、哈烈、沙哈魯、千里達、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Champa, Java, Samudera, Nepal, Malacca, Lambri, Herat, Shahrukh, Qilida, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year envoys came from Siam, Champa, Java, Samudera, Nepal, Malacca, Lambri, Herat, Shahrukh, Qilida, and Samarkand.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者再。

translations.literal: Ryukyu's central king came to offer tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: The central king of Ryukyu sent tribute twice.

sentences.zh: 十七年春二月乙酉，興安伯徐亨備興和、開平、大同。

translations.literal: In the spring of the seventeenth year, second month, on yiyou, Xing'an Earl Xu Heng prepared defenses at Xinghe, Kaiping, and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, second month of spring, on yiyou, Earl Xu Heng of Xing'an took charge of the garrisons at Xinghe, Kaiping, and Datong.

sentences.zh: 夏五月丙午，都督方政敗黎利於可藍柵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu, Regional Commander Fang Zheng defeated Li Li at Kelan stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on bingwu, Regional Commander Fang Zheng routed Li Li at Kelan stockade.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，免順天府去年水災田租。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on renwu, land tax for last year's flood in Shuntian Prefecture was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, the grain tax was waived for Shuntian fields ruined by flood the year before.

sentences.zh: 戊子，劉江殲倭寇於望海堝，封江廣寧伯。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Liu Jiang annihilated Japanese pirates at Wanghai'ao; Jiang was enfeoffed as Earl of Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Liu Jiang destroyed a wokou force at Wanghai'ao, and Liu Jiang was created Earl of Guangning.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，鄭和還。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen, Zheng He returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen, Zheng He came home from the voyage.

sentences.zh: 八月，中官馬騏激交阯乂安土知府潘僚反。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the eunuch Ma Qi provoked Yian Prefecture native official Pan Liao in Jiaozhi to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the eunuch Ma Qi goaded Pan Liao, the indigenous prefect of Yian in Jiaozhi, into revolt.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，慶雲見，禮臣請表賀，不許。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingchen, auspicious clouds appeared; ritual officials requested a congratulatory memorial, but permission was refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, felicitous clouds were seen; the Ministry of Rites asked to memorialize congratulations, but the Emperor would not allow it.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚辰，諭法司曰：「刑者，聖人所慎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengchen, the legal offices were instructed: "Punishment is what the sages treat with caution.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengchen, the judiciary was instructed: "The sages weigh every stroke of the lash.

sentences.zh: 匹夫匹婦不得其死，足傷天地之和，召水旱之災，甚非朕寬恤之意。

translations.literal: When any man or woman dies unjustly, it is enough to wound the harmony of Heaven and Earth and summon flood and drought—this is far from Our intent to show mercy.
translations.idiomatic: When innocent men and women perish, Heaven and Earth lose their balance and drought and flood follow—nothing could be further from Our will to temper justice with mercy.

sentences.zh: 自今，在外諸司死罪，鹹送京師審錄，三覆奏然後行刑。

translations.literal: From now on, capital cases in the outer provinces shall all be sent to the capital for review; after three memorials of confirmation, execution may proceed."
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth every death sentence in the provinces must be forwarded to the capital for rehearing, and the sentence may be carried out only after threefold memorial and assent."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，工部侍郎劉仲廉核實交阯戶口田賦，察軍民利病。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Vice Minister of Works Liu Zhonglian verified Jiaozhi population registers and land tax, and examined what benefited or harmed troops and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Vice Minister Liu Zhonglian of Works audited Jiaozhi household rolls and land tax and surveyed conditions among soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 是年，哈密、土魯番、失剌思、亦思弗罕、真臘、占城、哈烈、阿魯、南渤利、蘇門答剌、八答黑商、滿剌加入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Hami, Turfan, Shiraz, Isfahan, Zhenla, Champa, Herat, Aru, Lambri, Samudera, Badakhshan, and Malacca sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In that year tribute came from Hami, Turfan, Shiraz, Isfahan, Zhenla, Champa, Herat, Aru, Lambri, Samudera, Badakhshan, and Malacca.

sentences.zh: 琉球中山入貢者四。

translations.literal: Ryukyu's central king came to offer tribute four times.
translations.idiomatic: The central king of Ryukyu sent tribute four times.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月癸卯，李彬及都指揮孫霖、徐謜敗黎利於磊江。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighteenth year, first month, on guimao, Li Bin together with Regional Commanders Sun Lin and Xu Yan defeated Li Li on the Lei River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, first month of spring, on guimao, Li Bin with Regional Commanders Sun Lin and Xu Yan beat Li Li on the Lei River.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙子，翰林院學士楊榮、金幼孜為文淵閣大學士。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on bingzi, Hanlin Academician Yang Rong and Jin Youzi were made Grand Secretaries of the Wenyuan Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on bingzi, Yang Rong and Jin Youzi of the Hanlin Academy were appointed Grand Secretaries of the Wenyuan Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，擢人材，布衣馬麟等十三人為布政使、參政、參議。

translations.literal: On gengchen, men of talent were promoted: thirteen commoners including Ma Lin were made provincial administrators, vice administrators, and assistants.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen talent was sought out; thirteen men in plain dress, among them Ma Lin, were raised to provincial administration posts.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，薄臺妖婦唐賽兒作亂，安遠侯柳升帥師討之。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiyou, the sorceress Tang Sai'er of Botai raised rebellion; Anyuan Earl Liu Sheng led troops to suppress her.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiyou, the witch Tang Sai'er stirred up revolt at Botai, and Earl Liu Sheng of Anyuan marched against her.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，敗賊於禦石柵寨，都指揮劉忠戰沒，賽兒逸去。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinsi, bandits were defeated at Yushi stockade fort; Regional Commander Liu Zhong fell in battle, and Sai'er escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinsi, the rebels were beaten at Yushi stockade, but Regional Commander Liu Zhong was killed in the fighting and Sai'er got away.

sentences.zh: 甲申，山東都指揮僉事衛青敗賊於安丘，指揮王真敗賊於諸城，獻俘京師。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Shandong Regional Commander Wei Qing defeated bandits at Anqiu, and Commander Wang Zhen defeated bandits at Zhucheng; captives were presented at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Wei Qing, regional commander of Shandong, routed the rebels at Anqiu, and Commander Wang Zhen routed them at Zhucheng; prisoners were sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，山東布政使儲埏、張海，按察使劉本等坐縱盜誅。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Shandong Provincial Administrator Chu Yan and Zhang Hai, and Surveillance Commissioner Liu Ben and others were executed for condoning banditry.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Shandong provincial administrators Chu Yan and Zhang Hai, Surveillance Commissioner Liu Ben, and others were put to death for letting the rebels roam unchecked.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以逗留徵柳升下吏，尋釋之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Liu Sheng was summoned and imprisoned for delay; he was soon released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Liu Sheng was arrested for tardiness in the campaign, but was soon freed.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，左都督硃榮鎮遼東。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, Left Regional Commander Zhu Rong garrisoned Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, Left Regional Commander Zhu Rong took command in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，交阯參政侯保、馮貴禦賊，戰死。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Jiaozhi Vice Administrators Hou Bao and Feng Gui resisted bandits and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the Jiaozhi vice administrators Hou Bao and Feng Gui met the rebels in battle and were killed.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，北京地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu, Beijing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu, an earthquake struck Beijing.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，徐亨備開平。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, Xu Heng prepared defenses at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, Xu Heng again took up the Kaiping garrison.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，召皇太子。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi, the Crown Prince was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, the Crown Prince was called to court.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔自明年改京師為南京，北京為京師。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered that from the coming year the capital at Beijing would be called Nanjing, and Beijing would be the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict declared that from the next year the southern capital would be Nanjing and Beijing would become the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，李彬遣指揮使方政敗黎利於老撾。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, Li Bin sent Commander Fang Zheng to defeat Li Li in Laos.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on gengshen, Li Bin dispatched Commander Fang Zheng, who defeated Li Li in Laos.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰，以遷都北京詔天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, an edict announced to the realm the transfer of the capital to Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuchen, the removal of the capital to Beijing was proclaimed throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 是月，振青、菜饑。

translations.literal: That month, Qingzhou and Laizhou were relieved for famine.
translations.idiomatic: In that month famine relief was extended to Qing and Lai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，皇太子及皇太孫至北京。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, the Crown Prince and the Imperial Grandson arrived at Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, the Crown Prince and the imperial grandson reached Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，北京郊廟宮殿成。

translations.literal: On guihai, the suburban altars and palace halls of Beijing were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the suburban temples and palace halls at Beijing were finished.

sentences.zh: 是年，始設東廠，命中官剌事。

translations.literal: That year, the Eastern Depot was first established, with eunuchs assigned to gather intelligence.
translations.idiomatic: In that year the Eastern Depot was founded and eunuchs were charged with secret investigation.

sentences.zh: 古麻剌朗王來朝。

translations.literal: The king of Kamalagun came to court.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Kamalagun presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 暹羅、占城、爪哇、滿剌加、蘇門答剌、蘇祿西王入貢。

translations.literal: Siam, Champa, Java, Malacca, Samudera, and the western king of Sulu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute arrived from Siam, Champa, Java, Malacca, Samudera, and the western king of Sulu.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月甲子朔，奉安五廟神主於太廟。

translations.literal: In the spring of the nineteenth year, first month, on jiazi, the new moon, the spirit tablets of the five temples were installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, first month of spring, on jiazi, the new moon, the spirit tablets of the five temples were enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 禦奉天殿受朝賀，大宴。

translations.literal: He held court at Fengtian Hall to receive congratulations and gave a great banquet.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor held court at Fengtian Hall for New Year felicitations and gave a great feast.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On wuyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he proclaimed a general amnesty for the empire.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鄭和復使西洋。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zheng He again sailed to the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zheng He set out again for the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，都督僉事胡原帥師巡海捕倭。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinchou, Regional Commander Hu Yuan led troops to patrol the sea and capture Japanese pirates.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, Regional Commander Hu Yuan took a fleet to scour the coast for wokou.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，賜曾鶴齡等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinsi, Zeng Heling and other metropolitan graduates were granted jinshi with ranks of Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinsi, Zeng Heling and the new jinshi were graduated into the Presented Scholar and Regular Graduate ranks as their marks allowed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，奉天、華蓋、謹身三殿災，詔群臣直陳闕失。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi, the Fengtian, Huagai, and Jinshen halls burned; an edict ordered the ministers to speak plainly of shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengzi, fire destroyed the Fengtian, Huagai, and Jinshen halls, and the Emperor bade his ministers lay every fault before him without reserve.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔罷不便於民及不急諸務，蠲十七年以前逋賦，免去年被災田糧。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict abolished undertakings inconvenient to the people and not urgent, remitted tax arrears before the seventeenth year, and exempted grain tax on fields stricken by disaster last year.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he ordered an end to burdensome or needless projects, canceled tax arrears dating before the seventeenth year, and remitted last year's grain tax on disaster-stricken land.

sentences.zh: 己酉，萬壽節，以三殿災止賀。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Longevity Festival; because of the hall fire, congratulations were halted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou came the imperial birthday, but celebration was suspended because of the palace fire.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，蹇義等二十六人巡行天下，安撫軍民。

translations.literal: On guichou, Jian Yi and twenty-six others toured the realm to reassure troops and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Jian Yi and twenty-six others were sent on circuit through the empire to comfort soldiers and civilians.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，出建言給事中柯暹，御史何忠、鄭維桓、羅通等為知州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yichou, remonstrating Censor Ke Xian, Censors He Zhong, Zheng Weihuan, Luo Tong, and others were demoted to prefects.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou, the remonstrating censor Ke Xian and censors He Zhong, Zheng Weihuan, Luo Tong, and others were banished to prefectural posts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，令交阯屯田。

translations.literal: On gengyin, military colonies were ordered in Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin garrison farming was imposed in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，帝將北征，敕都督硃榮領前鋒，安遠侯柳升領中軍，寧陽侯陳懋領御前精騎，永順伯薛斌、恭順伯吳克忠領馬隊，武安侯鄭亨、陽武侯薛祿領左右哨，英國公張輔、成山侯王通領左右掖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, as the Emperor was about to campaign north in person, he charged Regional Commander Zhu Rong to lead the vanguard, Anyuan Earl Liu Sheng the central army, Ningyang Earl Chen Mao the elite cavalry before the throne, Yongshun Earl Xue Bin and Gongshun Earl Wu Kezhong the horse columns, Wu'an Earl Zheng Heng and Yangwu Earl Xue Lu the left and right scouts, and British Duke Zhang Fu and Chengshan Earl Wang Tong the left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, as the Emperor prepared to take the field against the north himself, he appointed Zhu Rong regional commander of the vanguard, Liu Sheng of Anyuan to the central army, Chen Mao of Ningyang to the imperial horse guard, Xue Bin of Yongshun and Wu Kezhong of Gongshun to the cavalry wings, Zheng Heng of Wu'an and Xue Lu of Yangwu to the left and right scouts, and Zhang Fu the British Duke and Wang Tong of Chengshan to the left and right flanks.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the first day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，分遣中官楊實、御史戴誠等核天下庫藏出納之數。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinyou, eunuchs Yang Shi, Censor Dai Cheng, and others were separately dispatched to audit treasury receipts and disbursements throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on xinyou, eunuch Yang Shi, Censor Dai Cheng, and others were sent in separate missions to audit provincial treasuries.

sentences.zh: 丙子，議北征軍餉，下戶部尚書夏原吉、刑部尚書吳中於獄，兵部尚書方賓自殺。

translations.literal: On bingzi, when northern campaign supplies were debated, Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji and Minister of Justice Wu Zhong were thrown into prison; Minister of War Fang Bin killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, as the northern expedition's logistics were debated, Revenue Minister Xia Yuanji and Justice Minister Wu Zhong were imprisoned, and War Minister Fang Bin took his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，下侍讀李時勉於獄。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Reader Li Shimian was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the reader Li Shimian was cast into prison.

sentences.zh: 甲申，發直隸、山西、河南、山東及南畿應天等五府，滁、和、徐三州丁壯運糧，期明年二月至宣府。

translations.literal: On jiashen, able-bodied men from Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, and the five prefectures of Yingtian and others in the southern metropolitan region, and from Chuzhou, Hezhou, and Xuzhou, were levied to transport grain, with delivery at Xuanfu expected by the second month of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen levies of labor were raised in Zhili, Shanxi, Henan, Shandong, and the southern capital districts, together with Chuzhou, Hezhou, and Xuzhou, to haul grain to Xuanfu by the second month of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 是年，瓦剌賢義王太平、安樂王把禿孛羅來朝。

translations.literal: That year, Oirat's Virtuous Prince Taiping and Prince Batu Boluo of Anda came to court.
translations.idiomatic: In that year Taiping, the Virtuous Prince of the Oirats, and Batu Boluo, Prince of Anda, came to offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 忽魯謨斯、阿丹、祖法兒、剌撒、不剌哇、木骨都東、古裏、柯枝、加異勒、錫蘭山、溜山、南渤利、蘇門答剌、阿魯、滿剌加、甘巴裏、蘇祿、榜葛剌、浡泥、古麻剌朗王入貢。

translations.literal: Hormuz, Aden, Dhofar, Las'a, Barbary, Mogadishu, Calicut, Cochin, Kayal, Ceylon, the Maldives, Lambri, Samudera, Aru, Malacca, Cambay, Sulu, Bengal, Brunei, and the king of Kamalagun sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came from Hormuz, Aden, Dhofar, Las'a, Barbary, Mogadishu, Calicut, Cochin, Kayal, Ceylon, the Maldives, Lambri, Samudera, Aru, Malacca, Cambay, Sulu, Bengal, Brunei, and Kamalagun.

sentences.zh: 暹羅入貢者再。

translations.literal: Siam came to offer tribute twice.
translations.idiomatic: Siam sent tribute twice.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月己未朔，日有食之，免朝賀，詔群臣修省。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twentieth year, first month, on jiwei, the new moon, there was a solar eclipse; court congratulations were waived and the ministers were ordered to cultivate themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, first month of spring, on jiwei, the new moon brought an eclipse; New Year audience was canceled and the ministers were told to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 壬申，豐城侯李彬卒於交阯。

translations.literal: On renshen, Fengcheng Earl Li Bin died in Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Earl Li Bin of Fengcheng died in Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，隆平侯張信、兵部尚書李慶分督北征軍餉，役民夫二十三萬五千有奇，運糧三十七萬石。

translations.literal: Second month, on yisi, Longping Earl Zhang Xin and Minister of War Li Qing separately supervised northern campaign supplies; more than 235,000 laborers were impressed and 370,000 piculs of grain transported.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi, Earl Zhang Xin of Longping and War Minister Li Qing were put in charge of northern expedition grain, pressing over 235,000 laborers to move 370,000 piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，詔有司遇災先振後聞。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingyin, an edict ordered that when disaster struck, local officials should relieve first and report afterward.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingyin, an edict required officials to give famine relief before memorializing the throne.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，阿魯臺犯興和，都指揮王喚戰死。

translations.literal: On yihai, Aru Temür raided Xinghe; Regional Commander Wang Huan died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Aru Temür struck Xinghe, and Regional Commander Wang Huan fell in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，親征阿魯臺，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Emperor campaigned in person against Aru Temür; the Crown Prince governed the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Emperor marched in person against Aru Temür while the Crown Prince remained to govern.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，發京師。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he left the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，次雞鳴山，阿魯臺遁。

translations.literal: On xinsi, he halted at Jiming Mountain; Aru Temür fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the army encamped at Jiming Mountain, and Aru Temür slipped away.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，次雲州，大閱。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, he halted at Yunzhou and held a great review.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yimao, he encamped at Yunzhou and held a grand inspection.

sentences.zh: 五月乙丑，獵於偏嶺。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on yichou, he hunted at Pianling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yichou, he hunted at Pianling.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大閱。

translations.literal: On dingmao, a great review was held.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he held another grand inspection.

sentences.zh: 辛未，次西涼亭。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, halted at Xiliang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the host encamped at Xiliang Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大閱。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, held a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the army was reviewed in full.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，次開平。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, halted at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the host encamped at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，令軍行出應昌，結方陣以進。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renchen, ordered the army to march out from Yingchang in square formation to advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renchen, the Emperor ordered the host to leave Yingchang in square battle order.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諜報阿魯臺兵攻萬全，諸將請分兵還擊，帝曰：「詐也。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, scouts reported that Aruqtai's troops were attacking Wanquan; the generals asked to divide forces and strike back; the Emperor said: "It is a ruse.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi scouts reported Aruqtai's men assaulting Wanquan, and the generals begged leave to detach a column and strike back; the Emperor said, "A trick.

sentences.zh: 彼慮大軍搗其巢穴，欲以牽制我師，敢攻城哉。

translations.literal: They fear our great army will smash their nest and wish to tie down our host—would they dare besiege a city?
translations.idiomatic: They dread a thrust at their lair and mean only to pin our army in place—they would never dare take a walled town."

sentences.zh: 」甲午，次陽和谷，寇攻萬全者果遁去。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, halted at Yanghe Valley; the raiders who had attacked Wanquan indeed fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the host halted at Yanghe Valley, and the force that had threatened Wanquan melted away as he had said.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，阿魯臺棄輜重於闊欒海側北遁，發兵焚之，收其牲畜，遂旋師。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiwei, Aruqtai abandoned baggage on the northern shore of the Kuoluan Sea and fled north; troops were sent to burn it, livestock was seized, and the army then turned back.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, Aruqtai cast off his baggage beside the Kuoluan Sea and fled north; detachments burned the stores, drove off the herds, and the Emperor began the march home.

sentences.zh: 謂諸將曰：「阿魯臺敢悖逆，恃兀良哈為羽翼也。

translations.literal: He told the generals: "Aruqtai dares rebel because he relies on the Uljin as his wings.
translations.idiomatic: He told his generals, "Aruqtai dares defy the throne only because the Uljin shield him.

sentences.zh: 當還師翦之。

translations.literal: We should turn the army back and cut them down."
translations.idiomatic: On the return march we shall cut those wings away."

sentences.zh: 」簡步騎二萬，分五道並進。

translations.literal: Selected twenty thousand infantry and cavalry and divided them into five columns to advance together.
translations.idiomatic: He chose twenty thousand foot and horse, divided them into five columns, and drove them forward together.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遇於屈裂兒河，帝親擊敗之，追奔三十里，斬部長數十人。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, met at the Quir River; the Emperor personally routed them, pursued thirty li, and beheaded dozens of chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he met the foe on the Quir River, broke them in person, chased them thirty li, and took the heads of dozens of clan chiefs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，徇河西，捕斬甚眾。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, swept west of the river; captured and beheaded very many.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he swept the west bank of the river, capturing and slaying a great multitude.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，兀良哈余黨詣軍門降。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, remaining Uljin factions came to the camp gate to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the surviving Uljin bands came to the camp gate and submitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，皇太子免南、北直隸、山東、河南郡縣水災糧芻共六十一萬有奇。

translations.literal: That month, the Crown Prince remitted grain and fodder for flood-stricken prefectures and counties of South and North Zhili, Shandong, and Henan totaling more than 610,000 (units).
translations.idiomatic: That month the Crown Prince remitted over 610,000 piculs of grain and fodder owed by flood-stricken counties in both capitals' districts, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，諸將分道者俱獻捷。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuxu, all generals on separate routes presented reports of victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu, every general on a separate route sent word of victory.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以班師詔天下。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, proclaimed withdrawal to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict announced withdrawal to the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，鄭亨、薛祿守開平。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Zheng Heng and Xue Lu garrisoned Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zheng Heng and Xue Lu were posted to hold Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 鄭和還。

translations.literal: Zheng He returned.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng He came home from the sea.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，至京師。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renxu, arrived at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, the Emperor reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，下左春坊大學士楊士奇於獄。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Grand Academician Yang Shiqi of the Left Secretariat was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Yang Shiqi, grand academician of the Left Secretariat, was imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，下吏部尚書蹇義、禮部尚書呂震於獄，尋俱釋之。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Minister of Personnel Jian Yi and Minister of Rites Lü Zhen were cast into prison; soon both were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the ministers Jian Yi and Lü Zhen were thrown into prison, but before long both were freed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，錄從征功，封左都督硃榮武進伯，都督僉事薛貴安順伯。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, merits of the campaign were recorded; Left Commissioner-in-chief Zhu Rong was enfeoffed Marquis of Wujin, and Vice Commissioner Xue Gui Marquis of Anshun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the rewards of the campaign were entered in the rolls: Zhu Rong, left commissioner-in-chief, was made Marquis of Wujin, and Xue Gui, vice commissioner, Marquis of Anshun.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳，分遣中官及朝臣八十人核天下倉糧出納之數。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guisi, eighty eunuchs and court officials were dispatched in separate parties to audit receipts and disbursements in granaries throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guisi, eighty eunuchs and courtiers were sent out to audit grain accounts in every storehouse under heaven.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，硃榮鎮遼東。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinmao, Zhu Rong was stationed to guard Liaodong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, Zhu Rong took command on the Liaodong frontier.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊寅，乾清宮災。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wuyin, the Qianqing Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuyin, fire consumed the Qianqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅、蘇門答剌、阿丹等國遣使隨貢方物。

translations.literal: That year, Siam, Samudera, Aden, and other states sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: That year envoys from Siam, Samudera, Aden, and other realms arrived with tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 占城、琉球中山、卜花兒、哈密、瓦剌、土魯番、爪哇入貢。

translations.literal: Champa, Ryukyu Zhongshan, Bughur, Hami, the Oirats, Turfan, and Java presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa, Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Bughur, Hami, the Oirats, Turfan, and Java sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月乙未，大禮天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, spring, first month, on the day yiwei, performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, on yiwei of the first month of spring, the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth in the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，交阯參將榮昌伯陳智追敗黎利於車來。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, regional vice commander Chen Zhi, Baron of Rongchang, pursued and defeated Le Loi at Chelai.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Chen Zhi, Baron of Rongchang and vice commander in Jiaozhi, routed Le Loi at Chelai.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，都指揮使鹿榮討柳州叛蠻，平之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jisi, Regional Commander Lu Rong campaigned against the rebel Miao of Liuzhou and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jisi, regional commander Lu Rong crushed the rebel Miao of Liuzhou and restored order.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，御史王愈等會決重囚，誤殺無罪四人，坐棄市。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Censor Wang Yu and others jointly judged serious prisoners and wrongly executed four innocents; they were sentenced to execution in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, the censors Wang Yu and his colleagues sat in joint judgment on capital cases and put four innocent men to death; for this they themselves were executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，免開封、南陽、衛輝、鳳陽等府去年水災田租。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day guimao, remitted last year's land tax from flood-stricken prefectures including Kaifeng, Nanyang, Weihui, and Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on guimao, land tax from the previous year was remitted for flood-stricken prefectures including Kaifeng, Nanyang, Weihui, and Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，常山護衛指揮孟賢等謀逆，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Meng Xian and others, commanders of the Changshan guard, plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Meng Xian and fellow commanders of the Changshan guard were found plotting treason and put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: At the new moon of the sixth month, gengxu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: At the new moon of the sixth month, gengxu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，復親征阿魯臺，安遠侯柳升、遂安伯陳英領中軍，武安侯鄭亨、保定侯孟瑛領左哨，陽武侯薛祿、新寧伯譚忠領右哨，英國公張輔、安平伯李安領左掖，成山侯王通、興安伯徐亨領右掖，寧陽侯陳懋領前鋒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuxu, again personally campaigned against Aruqtai: Marquis of Anyuan Liu Sheng and Baron of Sui'an Chen Ying led the central army; Marquis of Wu'an Zheng Heng and Marquis of Baoding Meng Ying led the left screen; Marquis of Yangwu Xue Lu and Baron of Xinning Tan Zhong led the right screen; Duke of Ying Zhang Fu and Baron of Anping Li An led the left wing; Marquis of Chengshan Wang Tong and Baron of Xing'an Xu Heng led the right wing; Marquis of Ningyang Chen Mao led the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu, the Emperor again took the field against Aruqtai: Liu Sheng, Marquis of Anyuan, and Chen Ying, Baron of Sui'an, held the center; Zheng Heng and Meng Ying the left and right screens; Xue Lu and Tan Zhong the flanking guards; Zhang Fu and Li An the left and right wings; Wang Tong and Xu Heng the supporting wings; and Chen Mao, Marquis of Ningyang, the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 庚子，釋李時勉，復其官。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Li Shimian was released and his office restored.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Shimian was freed and restored to his post.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Crown Prince oversaw the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Crown Prince was left to govern the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，發京師。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Emperor marched out from the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊申，次宣府，敕居庸關守將止諸司進奉。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, halted at Xuanfu and ordered the commander at Juyong Pass to stop all offices from sending presents.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the host halted at Xuanfu, and an edict told the Juyong Pass garrison to refuse all official tribute trains.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，大閱。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiyou, held a grand review.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the army was reviewed in full.

sentences.zh: 庚申，塞黑峪、長安嶺諸邊險要。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, blocked strategic passes including Heiyu and Chang'an Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the frontier passes at Heiyu, Chang'an Ridge, and other defiles were sealed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，皇太子免兩京、山東郡縣水災田租。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Crown Prince remitted land tax from flood-stricken counties of both capitals and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Crown Prince remitted land tax for flood-stricken counties in both capitals and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，次西陽河。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuzi, halted at the Xiyang River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi, the host encamped on the Xiyang River.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，聞阿魯臺為瓦剌所敗，部落潰散，遂駐師不進。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, heard that Aruqtai had been defeated by the Oirats and his tribes scattered; the army halted and did not advance.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi word came that the Oirats had broken Aruqtai and his tribes had scattered; the Emperor halted the advance and went no farther.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，次上莊堡，迤北王子也先土幹帥所部來降，封忠勇王，賜姓名金忠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiayin, halted at Shangzhuang Fort; Esen Togan, a prince of the far north, led his following to surrender, was enfeoffed Prince of Loyal Valor, and was granted the surname Jin and personal name Zhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, the host halted at Shangzhuang Fort; Esen Togan, a northern prince, brought his people in to submit, was made Prince of Loyal Valor, and received the imperial surname Jin with the personal name Zhong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，班師。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the army turned homeward.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，至京師。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiashen, arrived at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, the Emperor reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 是年，錫蘭山王來朝，又遣使入貢。

translations.literal: That year, the king of Ceylon came to court and also sent envoys presenting tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year the king of Ceylon came in person, and also sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 占城、古裏、忽魯謨斯、阿丹、祖法兒、剌撒、不剌哇、木骨都束、柯枝、加異勒、溜山、南渤利、蘇門答剌、阿魯、滿剌加、失剌思、榜葛剌、琉球中山入貢。

translations.literal: Champa, Calicut, Hormuz, Aden, Dhofar, Lasah, Barawa, Mogadishu, Cochin, Kayal, the Maldives, Lambri, Samudera, Aru, Malacca, Shiraz, Bengal, and Ryukyu Zhongshan presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute came from Champa, Calicut, Hormuz, Aden, Dhofar, Lasah, Barawa, Mogadishu, Cochin, Kayal, the Maldive isles, Lambri, Samudera, Aru, Malacca, Shiraz, Bengal, and Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月甲申，阿魯臺犯大同、開平，詔群臣議北征，敕邊將整兵俟命。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, spring, first month, on the day jiashen, Aruqtai raided Datong and Kaiping; an edict ordered the ministers to discuss a northern expedition, and border generals were ordered to ready troops awaiting command.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, on jiashen of the first month of spring, Aruqtai struck at Datong and Kaiping; the court was ordered to debate another northern campaign, and frontier commanders were told to ready their hosts for the summons.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，徵山西、山東、河南、陜西、遼東五都司及西寧、鞏昌、洮、岷各衛兵，期三月會北京及宣府。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, mobilized troops from the five regional commands of Shanxi, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and Liaodong and from the guards of Xining, Gongchang, Tao, and Min, to assemble at Beijing and Xuanfu by the third month.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu levies were drawn from the five regional commands of Shanxi, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and Liaodong and from the guards of Xining, Gongchang, Tao, and Min, with orders to muster at Beijing and Xuanfu by the third month.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth in the southern suburbs.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，鄭和復使西洋。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Zheng He was again dispatched to the Western Ocean.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zheng He sailed again for the Western Ocean.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，大閱，諭諸將親征。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, held a grand review and instructed the generals that he would campaign in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, the army was reviewed in full and the generals were told the Emperor would take the field himself.

sentences.zh: 命柳升、陳英領中軍，張輔、硃勇領左掖，王通、徐亨領右掖，鄭亨、孟瑛領左哨，薛祿、譚忠領右哨、陳懋、金忠領前鋒。

translations.literal: Ordered Liu Sheng and Chen Ying to lead the central army, Zhang Fu and Zhu Yong the left wing, Wang Tong and Xu Heng the right wing, Zheng Heng and Meng Ying the left screen, Xue Lu and Tan Zhong the right screen, and Chen Mao and Jin Zhong the vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Sheng and Chen Ying were given the center, Zhang Fu and Zhu Yong the left wing, Wang Tong and Xu Heng the right wing, Zheng Heng and Meng Ying the left screen, Xue Lu and Tan Zhong the right screen, and Chen Mao and Jin Zhong the vanguard.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜邢寬等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, bestowed jinshi degrees on Xing Kuan and others with differences in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the palace examinations were held and Xing Kuan and his fellows were granted jinshi titles in their several ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day wushen, the Crown Prince oversaw the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wushen, the Crown Prince was left to govern the realm.

sentences.zh: 己酉，發京師。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, departed the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Emperor marched out from the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚午，次隰寧，諜報阿魯臺走答蘭納木兒河，遂趨進師。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, halted at Yinning; scouts reported Aruqtai had fled to the Tala Namur River, and the army hurried forward.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the host halted at Yinning; scouts reported Aruqtai had fled toward the Tala Namur River, and the army pressed on in haste.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，次開平，使使招諭阿魯臺諸部。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, halted at Kaiping and sent envoys to summon Aruqtai's tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the Emperor encamped at Kaiping and sent heralds to call Aruqtai's tribes to submit.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，瘞道中遺骸。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, buried the bones left along the road.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the bones of the dead along the march were buried with rites.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宴群臣於應昌，命中官歌太祖禦制詞五章，曰：「此先帝所以戒後嗣也，雖在軍旅何敢忘。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, banqueted the officials at Yingchang, ordered eunuchs to sing five stanzas composed by the Taizu, and said: "These are what the Former Emperor used to warn his descendants—even amid the march how dare we forget."
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he feasted his ministers at Yingchang, had eunuchs sing five verses the Taizu had composed, and said, "These were the Former Emperor's warnings to his heirs—even on campaign we dare not forget them."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，次威遠州。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, halted at Weiyuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the host halted at Weiyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 復宴群臣，自制詞五章，命中官歌之。

translations.literal: Again banqueted the officials; composed five stanzas himself and ordered eunuchs to sing them.
translations.idiomatic: He feasted the ministers again, composed five verses of his own, and had eunuchs sing them.

sentences.zh: 皇太子令兔廣平、順德、揚州及湖廣、河南郡縣水災田租。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince ordered remission of flood land tax for prefectures and counties of Guangping, Shunde, Yangzhou, Huguang, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince remitted land tax for flood-stricken districts in Guangping, Shunde, Yangzhou, Huguang, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，前鋒至答蘭納木兒河，不見敵，命張輔等窮搜山谷三百里無所得，進駐河上。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, the vanguard reached the Tala Namur River and found no enemy; ordered Zhang Fu and others to search the valleys exhaustively for three hundred li with no result, then advanced and encamped on the river.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, the vanguard came to the Tala Namur River and found no foe; Zhang Fu and others were sent to scour the valleys for three hundred li without success, and the host encamped on the riverbank.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，陳懋等引兵抵白邙山，以糧盡還。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Chen Mao and others led troops to Mount Baibang but returned for lack of grain.
