translations.idiomatic: On guihai Chen Mao and his column pushed as far as Mount Baibang, then turned back when provisions ran out.

sentences.zh: 甲子，班師，命鄭亨等以步卒西會於開平。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, withdrew; ordered Zheng Heng and others with infantry to meet west at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the army began its withdrawal; Zheng Heng and the foot regiments were ordered to rendezvous westward at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 壬申夜，南京地震。

translations.literal: On the night of renshen, there was an earthquake in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the night of renshen Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚辰，勒石於清水源之崖。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day gengchen, inscribed a stone on the cliff at Qingshuiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengchen, the Emperor had a stele cut on the cliff at Qingshuiyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣呂震以旋師諭太子，詔告天下。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, sent Lü Zhen to inform the Crown Prince of withdrawal; an edict proclaimed this to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Lü Zhen was dispatched to tell the Crown Prince of the withdrawal, and an edict announced it throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己丑，次蒼崖戍，不豫。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, halted at Cangya Post; fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the host halted at Cangya Post, and the Emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，至榆木川，大漸。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, reached Yumuchuan; grew critically ill.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he came to Yumuchuan and sank into grave illness.

sentences.zh: 遺詔傳位皇太子，喪禮一如高皇帝遺制。

translations.literal: A testamentary edict transmitted the throne to the Crown Prince; funeral rites were to follow the testamentary provisions of the Hongwu Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: By testamentary edict he passed the throne to the Crown Prince and ordered mourning rites after the pattern left by the Hongwu Emperor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，崩，年六十有五。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, died; aged sixty-five.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he died, aged sixty-five.

sentences.zh: 太監馬雲密與大學士楊榮、金幼孜謀，以六軍在外，秘不發喪，熔錫為椑以斂，載以龍舉，所至朝夕上膳如常儀。

translations.literal: Eunuch Ma Yun secretly conspired with Grand Secretaries Yang Rong and Jin Youzi; because the six armies were abroad, they concealed the death, melted tin for a coffin to enshroud the body, carried it on the dragon palanquin, and at each halt morning and evening meals were served as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Ma Yun secretly joined Grand Secretaries Yang Rong and Jin Youzi in hiding the death while the host was still in the field: tin was melted to fashion a coffin, the body was borne in the imperial litter, and at every halt the morning and evening meals were set out as though nothing had changed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，楊榮偕禦馬監少監海壽馳訃皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Yang Rong with Vice Director Hai Shou of the Imperial Horse Directorate galloped to announce the death to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Yang Rong and Hai Shou, vice director of the Imperial Horse Directorate, raced ahead to bring word of the death to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，次武平鎮，鄭亨步軍來會。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, halted at Wuping; Zheng Heng's infantry joined.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the procession halted at Wuping, where Zheng Heng's foot soldiers came up.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，楊榮等至京師，皇太子即日遣太孫奉迎於開平。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day jiachen, Yang Rong and the others reached the capital; the Crown Prince that same day sent the Grand Heir to meet the procession at Kaiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiachen, Yang Rong and his party reached the capital, and that same day the Crown Prince sent the Grand Heir to meet the bier at Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次雕鶚谷，皇太孫至軍中發喪。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, halted at Diaoe Valley; the Grand Heir arrived at the army and announced the death.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the host halted at Diaoe Valley; the Grand Heir came to the army and the mourning was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，及郊，皇太子迎入仁智殿，加殮納辛宮。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, reaching the suburbs, the Crown Prince received the body into the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom and laid it in the state coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, at the capital outskirts, the Crown Prince received the bier into the Hall of Benevolent Wisdom and laid the Emperor in the state coffin.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，上尊謚曰體天弘道高明廣運聖武神功純仁至孝文皇帝，廟號太宗，葬長陵。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renwu, the posthumous title was raised as Emperor Wen, Cultivated in Pure Benevolence and Utmost Filial Piety, of Sagely Martial Divine Merit, Broadly Favored, Lofty and Bright, and Grandly Conforming to Heaven; temple name Taizong; burial at Changling.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, he was given the posthumous title Emperor Wen, Cultivated in Pure Benevolence and Utmost Filial Piety, of Sagely Martial Divine Merit, Broadly Favored, Lofty and Bright, and Grandly Conforming to Heaven, with temple name Taizong, and was buried at Changling.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十七年九月，改上尊謚曰啟天弘道高明肇運聖武神功純仁至孝文皇帝，廟號成祖。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the seventeenth year of Jiajing, the posthumous title was revised as Emperor Wen, Cultivated in Pure Benevolence and Utmost Filial Piety, of Sagely Martial Divine Merit, Broadly Favored, Lofty and Bright, and Grandly Initiating Conformity to Heaven; temple name Chengzu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the seventeenth year of Jiajing the posthumous title was changed to Emperor Wen, Cultivated in Pure Benevolence and Utmost Filial Piety, of Sagely Martial Divine Merit, Broadly Favored, Lofty and Bright, and Grandly Initiating Conformity to Heaven, and the temple name was set as Chengzu.
